question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

To move into or through something
solution:
The correct answer is: Penetrate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Penetrate"** means to move into or through something. (प्रवेश करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The bullet could not **penetrate **the bulletproof vest.
 
 
 
• **"To move into or through something"** refers to making a way into or through a physical barrier or space. (किसी चीज़ के अंदर या उसके माध्यम से जाना)
 
• **​**Hence, we can infer that the word for "**To move into or through something**" is "**Penetrate**".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Perpetuate** (स्थायी बनाना): To make something continue indefinitely.

 
 
• **Example:** The new policy will **perpetuate **the existing inequalities.
 
 
 
• **Transparent** (पारदर्शी): Allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen.
 
 
• **Example: **The glass is so **transparent **that you can see clearly through it.
 
 
 
• **Cross** (पार करना): To move from one side to another.
 
 
• **Example:** We need to **cross **the river to reach the village.
